title: int:Trade
description: An energy trade between a buyer and a seller, from matching through delivery verification. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument. Mirrors the Rust EwdsTradeDto (camelCase wire form; RFC 3339 creation timestamp).

tradeId.description: Hyphenated UUIDv4 trade ID. Imports accept either letter case; reads/events use lowercase UUID text. IRI: int:tradeId.

bidId.description: FK to bid Order. IRI: int:bidId.

buyerId.description: Original off-chain owner ID of the buying facility, not an on-chain hash or wallet. Preserved exactly and case-sensitive. IRI: int:buyerId.

residualBidId.description: Residual bid ID; null means absence; otherwise a hyphenated UUIDv4.

offerId.description: FK to offer Order. IRI: int:offerId.

sellerId.description: Original off-chain owner ID of the selling facility, not an on-chain hash or wallet. Preserved exactly and case-sensitive. IRI: int:sellerId.

residualOfferId.description: Residual offer ID; null means absence; otherwise a hyphenated UUIDv4.

tradeStatus.description: Trade lifecycle status: matched when included in a block indexed by the listener (no confirmation depth), executed after verification without penalties, settled when the trade has been processed in the Settlement market (transition not yet implemented), or terminal penalized after a delivery penalty. IRI: int:tradeStatus.

tradeQuantity.description: Traded energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:tradeQuantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

tradePrice.description: Settled trade price in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:tradePrice. Unit: EUR/kWh.

timestamp.description: Trade creation timestamp, unchanged by status updates. IRI: int:tradedAt. RFC 3339. Lifecycle notifications carry the status-change time in the event envelope's occurredAt.
